summary: Run queue shows the jobs an agent has lined up in three parts: the job running, raised on its own card with its agent, its steps, a progress bar and the time left; the jobs up next, each with its agent and when it should start; and the jobs done, each with how long it took and a green tick. A strip across the top shows the whole queue at a glance, and a failed step offers a Retry button.
use: When your agent works through several jobs in a row and people want to see what is running, what comes next and what is done.
When a step can fail and people should be able to retry just that step.
When people want to know how long the queue still has to go.
features: Each job in `jobs` has a `title`, an `agent` and an `icon` for its badge, a `state` (queued, running, failed or done) and its `steps`. Running and failed jobs sit under Running, queued ones under Up next and finished ones under Done, in the order of `jobs`.
A job glides from one part to the next when its `state` changes, and the jobs it passes glide with it.

The running job shows its agent and the step it is on, a progress bar from `progress` (or the share of its steps that are done) and its steps with what each came to (`meta`). `time` is the words at the end of the row: when a waiting job starts, what is left of a running one, or how long a done one took.
A failed step turns its job red and, with `onRetry`, shows a Retry button that calls it with the job and step indexes.
An empty part says so ("Nothing waiting", "Nothing done yet"). Once every job is done, Running and Up next fold away and "All 4 jobs done" takes their place, with `summary` under it.
A Detailed / Compact switch shows or folds away the running job's steps. Control it with `density` and `onDensityChange`.
The status line defaults to "1 of 4 done", and `status` replaces it. The queue sits on its card by default, and `bare` lays it flat in a chat.
a11y: Running, Up next and Done are labelled lists, so screen readers announce each part and how many jobs it holds.
The density switch is a `role="group"` labelled "Density", and the current option has `aria-pressed="true"`.
Folded steps and folded parts are `inert` and `aria-hidden`, so their Retry buttons leave the tab order.

faq.q: How do I let people retry a failed step?
faq.a: Pass `onRetry`. It is called with the job index and the step index, and you rerun the step and set its `state` back to 'running'. Without `onRetry`, failed steps show no button.

faq.q: Does a job's state follow its steps automatically?
faq.a: No. You set each job's `state` and each step's `state` yourself. The component only works out the progress bar from the done steps when `progress` is left out, and the counts from the job states.

faq.q: Can I start in the compact view?
faq.a: Yes. Set `defaultDensity="compact"`, or control `density` from your own state.
